answer: LIST THE COUNT OF Case [has CaseVisacls: 'H-1B'] [has CaseStatustag s WHERE upper(s) = 'CERTIFIED'] * 100 / THE COUNT OF Case [has CaseVisacls: 'H-1B']

LIST cat, tot, cert, rate FROM Case c OPTIONALLY has Attorney OPTIONALLY has AttorneyLawmail m AND ALSO has CaseStatustag s AND ALSO if(length(coalesce(m, '')) > 0, 'With Attorney', 'Self-Represented') AS cat AND ALSO if(upper(s) = 'CERTIFIED', 1, 0) AS ci AND ALSO THE DISTINCT COUNT OF c GROUPED BY cat AS tot AND ALSO THE SUM OF ci GROUPED BY cat AS cert AND ALSO round(cert * 100 / tot, 2) AS rate

LIST st, tot, cert, rate FROM Case c has Attorney has AttorneyHighestCourtState st AND ALSO has CaseStatustag s AND ALSO if(upper(s) = 'CERTIFIED', 1, 0) AS ci AND ALSO THE COUNT OF c GROUPED BY st AS tot AND ALSO THE SUM OF ci GROUPED BY st AS cert AND ALSO round(cert * 100 / tot, 2) AS rate WHERE tot >= 3 ORDERED WITH rate DESCENDING THE FIRST 3

LIST cat, n, pct FROM Case e has CaseBeginday b AND ALSO has CaseRecvday r AND ALSO (castInteger(substr(b, length(b) - 3, 4)) - castInteger(substr(r, 1, 4))) * 12 + castInteger(substr(b, instr(b, '/') + 1, 2)) - castInteger(substr(r, 6, 2)) AS mo AND ALSO if(mo < 0, 'After Start Date', if(mo = 0, 'Same Month', if(mo <= 3, '1-3 Months Before', if(mo <= 6, 'Optimal Window (4-6 Months)', 'Early Filing')))) AS cat AND ALSO THE COUNT OF e GROUPED BY cat AS n AND ALSO round(n * 100 / THE COUNT OF Case, 2) AS pct ORDERED WITH n DESCENDING

DEFINE StateCount ::= LIST st, n FROM Case e has Worksite has WorksiteWstate st AND ALSO THE COUNT OF e GROUPED BY st AS n
LIST l, c FROM WorksiteWstate s has StateCount StateCountN n AND ALSO 1 AS g AND ALSO THE LIST OF s SEPARATED BY ', ' GROUPED BY g AS l AND ALSO THE COUNT OF s GROUPED BY g AS c WHERE n > 1.5 * THE AVERAGE WorksiteWstate has StateCount StateCountN

DEFINE AV ::= LIST c, nv FROM Case c has Attorney a AND ALSO has CaseVisacls v AND ALSO THE COUNT OF c WITHIN a, v AS nv
DEFINE AttTotal ::= LIST a, na FROM Case c has Attorney a AND ALSO THE COUNT OF c GROUPED BY a AS na
DEFINE AttTypes ::= LIST a, dv FROM Case c has Attorney a AND ALSO has CaseVisacls v AND ALSO THE DISTINCT COUNT OF v GROUPED BY a AS dv
DEFINE AttDom ::= LIST a, mx FROM Case c has Attorney a AND ALSO c has AV AVNv nv AND ALSO THE MAXIMUM nv GROUPED BY a AS mx
LIST cat, k, aasi, adom FROM Attorney a has AttTotal AttTotalNa na AND ALSO a has AttTypes AttTypesDv dv AND ALSO a has AttDom AttDomMx mx AND ALSO (1 - dv / THE DISTINCT COUNT OF v IN Case has CaseVisacls v) AS asi AND ALSO (mx * 100 / na) AS domp AND ALSO if(domp > 80, 'Specialist', if(dv <= 3, 'Hybrid Practitioner', 'Generalist')) AS cat AND ALSO THE COUNT OF a GROUPED BY cat AS k AND ALSO THE AVERAGE asi GROUPED BY cat AS aa AND ALSO THE AVERAGE domp GROUPED BY cat AS ad AND ALSO round(aa, 2) AS aasi AND ALSO round(ad, 2) AS adom WHERE na >= 5 ORDERED WITH k DESCENDING

LIST nc, n, pct FROM Case e has homefirm Employer has EmployerNaicsCode nc AND ALSO THE COUNT OF e GROUPED BY nc AS n AND ALSO round(n * 100 / THE COUNT OF Case, 2) AS pct WHERE n > 15 * THE COUNT OF Case / 100 ORDERED WITH pct DESCENDING

LIST v, a FROM Case [has CaseStatustag s WHERE upper(s) = 'CERTIFIED'] has CaseVisacls v AND ALSO has CaseRecvday r AND ALSO has CaseDecisionday d AND ALSO days_between(d, r) AS ap AND ALSO THE AVERAGE ap GROUPED BY v AS a ORDERED WITH a DESCENDING
